message.content:
Based on my search, here's what I found about watching MSNBC live streaming online:

## Official Streaming Options

**Peacock (NBCUniversal's streaming service)**
- MSNBC is available on Peacock, which offers both a **free tier** and premium subscriptions
- You can stream MSNBC live by going to www.peacock.com, clicking on the MSNBC tab, and selecting "Live"
- The free plan has limited content, while Peacock Premium provides full access

**MSNBC App**
- MSNBC has an official app for iPhone, iPad, and iTouch
- Live streaming is available for **authenticated subscribers** of participating cable, satellite, and telco services
- Some video clips are accessible without a subscription

## Important Note: MSNBC Has Rebranded to "MS NOW"

As of November 15, 2024, MSNBC officially rebranded to **"MS NOW"** (My Source for News, Opinion, and the World). This change occurred because:
- Comcast spun off MSNBC and other cable networks into a new company called **Versant**
- The network can no longer use the NBC name or peacock logo
- The programming and editorial stance remain the same—only the name changed

## Free Streaming Options (Third-Party)

Several third-party websites claim to offer free MSNBC/MS NOW live streams:
- **usnewson.com/watch/msnbc-live** - Claims to offer free HD streaming
- **livenewschat.eu/msnbc-live-stream/** - Offers free streaming with MS NOW rebranding
- **livenewstime.com/msnbc-live/** - Claims free streaming available
- **newslive.com** - Claims worldwide free access

**Caution:** These unofficial free streaming sites may not be authorized and could pose security risks or have unreliable streams.

## Streaming Services with MSNBC (Paid Options)

| Service | Monthly Cost | Free Trial |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| Sling TV | Starting at ~$40 | Yes |
| Hulu + Live TV | $54.99+ | Yes |
| YouTube TV | ~$73 | Yes |
| fuboTV | Starting at ~$75 | Yes |
| AT&T TV Now | Varies | Yes |

MSNBC is also available on DirecTV channel 356.

## Summary

While there are websites claiming to offer completely free MSNBC/MS NOW streaming without authentication, the **legitimate free options** are limited:
- Peacock's free tier (with limited content)
- Short video clips on the MSNBC app without subscription
- Free trials from paid streaming services

For full, reliable live streaming, you'll typically need either a cable/satellite subscription for authentication or a paid streaming service subscription.
